1. On your Kindle, open Settings › Wi-Fi & Bluetooth › Bluetooth devices.

2. Search for available devices and select "Kindle Click" to pair.

3. Once connected, page forward/back and brightness buttons will control your Kindle.

Note: The volume keys on your phone will also turn pages while connected.
Waiting for Kindle: it connects when awake. If it doesn\'t within a few seconds, open Settings › Wi-Fi and Bluetooth › Bluetooth devices on your Kindle.
